TestStoragePaths.test_processing_dir_gua.note: The SQLite processing inbox is retired (PG-C2 #641; docs/postgresql-architecture.md §11.5): Files for Processing is an upload queue of managed objects, so StorageConfig has no processing_dir and no /data/for_processing fallback, and a set PRKS_FOR_PROCESSING_DIR is refused at start whatever its value. The testing-mode guard that refused an inbox under /data or <repo>/data is subsumed: no inbox value is accepted in any mode.
